question: What practice concerning the soul is being said to have been told to the addressed one, and to whom is that act of telling directed?
premises: This practice of the soul is indicated.
The telling is directed to you.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: Agent of telling not stated within the verse
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
